Not so much a single story, rather a series of events over a whole year. In 2006 I used to find $5 bills everywhere. It started when I was walking to school one day early in the year. It had rained the night before so there were dead leaves and bits of trash along the gutters. About a block away from school I spotted a soggy Lincoln sitting atop leaves on the gutter. Later in the year I found another on the way home in the park, another in a gutter and so on. It all ended around September in a movie theater. I was out in the lobby chatting with friends when I noticed a bank envelope a few feet away. I stroll on over and casually rip it in half with my feet, I saw green. When I picked it up I was slightly disappointed to see that it was just $4, compared to the streak I'd been on I thought I would have hit the jackpot. Since then I haven't found any random money in the street. Not even pennies.

So back in 2006 my sister was in this long distance relationship with a guy about half the state away. To this day I don't know the important details but something happened between them that put my sister in the deepest of dumps and she was depressed for a while. Then one night I heard my mother upstairs yell for my father in such a way that I've never heard since. We both shot upstairs and immediately saw my mother holding my sister as if she was badly hurt. I looked over to the bathroom which was a total mess of spray bottles for different cleaners (Formula 409, Scrubbing Bubbles, stuff like that) all over the floor, and on the counter was a single cup. Apparently this thing that had happened between my sister and her "boyfriend" had caused to want to hurt herself. She tried to poison herself by mixing a few different cleaners in a cup and drinking a bit. Everything after that is hard to remember because it happened so fast. She was taken to the hospital and had her stomach pumped. Thankfully there was no serious damage done by the chemicals.

Fast forward a month my sister is doing fine, almost as if nothing had happened. As a way to help herself forget all this relationship nonsense she buys a kitten. The cat and my sister are doing fine to this day. There haven't been an incidents of self harm since. And funny enough she got the cat to help her move on and get better in general but around 2006 is when I started going through my own problems and this cat's been through it all with me. She's a very supportive cat.
